email.subject: Stride Group Fitness: two quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I checked Stride Group Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call button, so anyone searching on their phone has to copy and dial your number manually, and your hours aren't listed, so people checking if a class is running right now just leave. Your page title also doesn't mention fitness or Harbor Falls, which hurts how you show up in search, and there are no reviews displayed to build trust with new visitors.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what I'd change?

Alex
